name: Fiestas del Pueblo
source:
Fiestas del Pueblo is a visual novel made up of four different stories. The stories are all set in a same place in the same period of time. The rest of connections are ambiguous.

[From [url=https://moonlight-demon.itch.io/fiestas-del-pueblo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Fiestas del Pueblo是一部由四个不同故事组成的视觉小说。这些故事都发生在同一时间段的同一地点。其余的联系是不明确的。

[来自[url=https://moonlight-demon.itch.io/fiestas-del-pueblo]Itch.io[/url]]
